SMTO-GML-0043 — SMTO doesn't know who to send this email to

GUID: 2b4a8310-2058-48eb-8de4-61615f1226b0
Slug: gmail-recipient-missing
Domain: GML · Subsystem: gml

What happened

  • The email has nobody in its To line, so SMTO stopped before creating the draft or sending it. Nothing was sent.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In the conversation, give the recipient's full email address, for example 'Send it to alice@example.com'. SMTO needs at least one address for the To line and couldn't work one out.
  2. For a reply, include the address too, because the original email had no sender address SMTO could read. Without a readable sender in the original, SMTO can't tell who should get the reply.
  3. Ask SMTO to show you the draft first and check the To line before you approve sending. Checking first makes sure the email goes only to the people you intend.

What success looks like

  • The draft shows the right address in the To line, and the email appears in Gmail's Drafts or Sent.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, along with the address you gave. Don't keep repeating the same request without adding a recipient.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Gmail message construction ended with an empty To list: a compose request had no To address, or reply recipient derivation found no usable address in the thread.

What this means

  • Compose/reply recipient derivation produces an empty To address list. Gmail provider receipts and exact account/message identities determine effects. Authorization, pagination or presentation failure cannot undo a send or other mutation; diagnostic rendering performs no mailbox or OAuth request.

Why this can happen

  • Compose/reply recipient derivation produces an empty To address list.

How to diagnose it

  • Review derived reply recipients or the explicit To field against the intended account/thread.

How to fix it

  • build_compose_mime requires at least one To address; build_reply_mime falls back through Reply-To/From, other thread participants and finally the account itself, and fails only when all are empty. Supply an explicit to list in the compose or reply request and review the draft preview before sending.
  • Add the intended recipient in the To field and review the draft before sending.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The exact intended recipient is present in the reviewed message.

What not to do

  • Do not repeatedly submit the same invalid input; correct the named constraint first.

Technical notes

  • Gmail provider receipts and exact account/message identities determine effects. Authorization, pagination or presentation failure cannot undo a send or other mutation; diagnostic rendering performs no mailbox or OAuth request.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
